description.text:
The runner-up deck of the Senior Division at the 2008 World Championships, built for speed and disruption. Blissey sets up fast and soaks up a lot of damage, while Trainer cards such as Cessation Crystal, Crystal Beach and Energy Removal 2 get in the way of the opponent's plans. The 2008 World Championships were held at the Hilton Orlando Lake Buena Vista in Orlando, Florida, from 15 to 17 August 2008.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2008 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
